title: Factorial identity for successive choices
statement: For natural numbers $n,d,t$ satisfying $td\le n$, the identity $\left(\prod_{j=0}^{t-1}\binom{n-jd}{d}\right)(d!)^t(n-td)!=n!$ holds.
